title: Free Circle Actions and Positive Ricci Curvature on Manifolds with the Cohomology Ring of $S^2\times S^5$
summary: We classify which of the 672 oriented diffeomorphism types of closed, simply-connected spin 7-manifolds with the cohomology ring of $S^2\times S^5$ admit a free circle action. In addition, we show that whenever such an action exists, there exist infinitely many pairwise non-equivalent free circle actions. Finally, in almost all cases where such an action exists, we construct invariant Riemannian metrics of positive Ricci curvature.
